body:
## What to build

Rest-basis correction passed numerical tests on exported/reloaded equal-topology derivatives; derivative visual playback did not run. Different proportions/anatomy, semantic maps, IK/contact and root-motion policy were not established. Keep the result bounded.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Play naive and corrected controlled derivatives on the same renderer/fixture conditions.
- [ ] Compare observed motion with retained numerical errors and rest/identity controls.
- [ ] List supported basis transformations explicitly.
- [ ] Do not claim arbitrary rig, IK, root-motion or VaM compatibility from this experiment.

## Blocked by

None (can start immediately).

## Evidence and scope

[retarget A/B experiment](https://github.com/Derek-X-Wang/nvwa/blob/d74493d/experiments/04-retarget-basis/REPORT.md)

Known M0 gap; independent of thin M1.
title: Visually verify controlled retarget derivatives before broader rig claims
